questions.key_step: Determinant (N-2)(N-3) nonzero; count die faces.
questions.justification: One familiar move (determinant) plus counting 4 of 6 faces; like 2026-P1-Q3 (L1).

questions.key_step: Measure-zero events: need a counterexample for both statements.
questions.justification: Two statements, each needs a counterexample on a non-discrete space; conceptual but short; below 2024-P1-Q2 (L3).

questions.key_step: AM-GM gives M=1089; x(66-x)>=605 gives 11<=x<=55; count multiples of 3.
questions.justification: Routine chain of three standard steps; no insight; like 2021-P1-Q5 (L2).

questions.key_step: Integer G.P. with rational ratio p/q is (kq^2,kpq,kp^2); count all ratios.
questions.justification: Numerical answer; casework over many ratios, non-integer ratios are easily missed; one slip changes the count; like 2023-P2-Q10 (L4).

questions.key_step: P(W_n)=2^(n-1)P(W_1); rank of CDBEA is 64.
questions.justification: Two ideas linked (dictionary rank, G.P. weights) with exact algebraic form; like 2023-P2-Q2 (L3).

questions.key_step: Bayes with hypergeometric likelihoods; solve binomial-coefficient equation for n.
questions.justification: Bayes plus solving for n through combination ratios, no options; like 2024-P1-Q2 (L3).

questions.key_step: x+y=10 forces x in {4,5,6}; add three binomial terms.
questions.justification: Routine binomial sum with exact arithmetic; like 2021-P1-Q5 (L2).

questions.key_step: Hypergeometric table, E(X^2)-E(X)^2.
questions.justification: Standard table and variance, short chain; like 2024-P1-Q13 (L4) but without the non-standard setup.

questions.key_step: sigma=mu+2 gives quadratic in alpha; reject alpha=0 (duplicate value).
questions.justification: Chain of K, mean, variance, quadratic and a rejection step that is easy to miss; like 2024-P1-Q13 (L4) but simpler.

questions.key_step: Hypergeometric table, variance, reduce fraction.
questions.justification: Same as the earlier variance question with larger numbers; routine.

questions.key_step: Y=3-X; means from the hypergeometric table.
questions.justification: One standard idea (mean of a distribution), direct arithmetic.

questions.key_step: b^2>=4ac, count pairs for each b.
questions.justification: Short enumeration; one place to slip (repeats allowed); like 2021-P1-Q5 (L2).

questions.key_step: Tail probabilities of a geometric variable, conditional probability.
questions.justification: Routine series sums and a conditional probability; like 2023-P2-Q2 (L3) but simpler.

questions.key_step: D<0 gives N<=3; add three geometric terms.
questions.justification: Two routine steps; no insight.

questions.key_step: Geometric mean via series sum x^(r-1).
questions.justification: Standard infinite-series mean; routine.

questions.key_step: Pascal's rule gives i/21; sum of cubes.
questions.justification: Two standard identities chained; options available to check; like 2025-P2-Q10 (L4) but much easier.

questions.key_step: a0=f(0), a2=f''(0)/2 or coefficient from the binomial theorem.
questions.justification: Standard coefficient extraction; routine.

questions.key_step: Complement: product odd iff all elements odd.
questions.justification: One familiar move.

questions.key_step: Expand (1-t^6)^3 (1-t)^-3; only 1 matters; stars and bars.
questions.justification: Familiar expansion trick plus stars and bars; routine.

questions.key_step: Ratios of consecutive coefficients give linear equations in n and r.
questions.justification: Standard two-equation setup; routine.
